judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

Mummineni Sudheer Kumar, J.:— Learned counsel for the petitioner states that in view of efflux of time, the relief sought in this writ petition has become infructuous.

2. In view of the same, this writ petition is dismissed as infructuous. No costs. Consequently, connected miscellaneous petitions are closed.
